record.question: Indian State with the highest urban population is
record.explanation: Answer C: Maharashtra. Maharashtra had the largest absolute urban population among Indian states in Census 2011, approximately 5.08 crore. The question asks population count, not the highest percentage urban: those are different measures. Historical/source note: Absolute Census 2011 urban population; not the percentage urban or a current estimate. Reference: https://mahades.maharashtra.gov.in/files/publication/esm2122_e.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
